The '''Celanon–Sprizen Negotiation''' was a trade dispute between the [[Celanon system/Legends|Celanon]] and [[Sprizen system/Legends|Sprizen systems]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> two [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that lay along the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Jedi Consular]]s from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] settled the negotiations in favor of the [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] from Celanon, although the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], which began in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3681 BBY]], caused the dispute to reopen when trade boundaries were shifted.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Celanon–Sprizen Negotiation was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
